'''''Hlobane Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 3 [[R-41 Starchaser]]s used by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They were launched from [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Intombe]]'' to provide cover for [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] group [[Ibutho group|Ibutho]] so that they could capture [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvette]] group [[Hashim group|Hashim]]. They were unsuccessful and all fighters were destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
